title: Research Navigator
description: Looks things up on the web and synthesizes a sourced, skimmable answer.

title: Literature Summarizer
description: Summarizes papers or articles and flags the length and density of the source text.

title: Fact-Check Analyst
description: Investigates a claim online and reports what the evidence supports.

title: Market Research Scout
description: Gathers a quick competitive and market snapshot around a product idea.

title: Survey Question Designer
description: Drafts unbiased survey questions that actually measure what you're after.

title: Competitor Tracker
description: Looks up a competitor and summarizes their current positioning and offering.

title: Interview Question Planner
description: Drafts a set of open-ended research interview questions around a topic.

title: Source Credibility Checker
description: Looks up a source and flags reasons to trust or question it.
